title_zh: 京东：自建物流的电商巨头
title_en: Chinese Companies (8/20): JD.com, the E-Commerce Giant That Built Its Own Logistics
note_en: When a 比 comparison covers a whole group, Chinese often adds 都 before the adjective: 京东的送货速度比很多竞争对手都快 "JD delivered faster than most of its competitors." The sentence works without 都, but 都 stresses that JD beats every one of them. Notice also that the adjective 快 takes no ending at all; English needs "faster," Chinese just says 比…快.
